Programs for children & young adults

Friendship grows best in a circle that welcomes everyone.

Empower Social Circle is a warm, judgment-free space where children and young adults with special needs practice social skills, make real friends, and discover how good it feels to belong.

Join the Circle See Why Join
Why Join Our Circle

A community built around belonging.

Empower Social Circle gives every child and young adult room to be seen, supported, and celebrated — while quietly building the skills and confidence that carry into everyday life. Every program is shaped around each participant's own strengths, and every activity gives kids a safe place to practice speaking up, listening, and connecting without fear of judgment.

🗣️

Grow in Confidence

Kids and young adults practice introductions, group conversation, and speaking up in front of others — at their own pace, in a group that's cheering for them.

🤝

Build Real Friendships

Structured play and shared experiences turn strangers into steady friends, in an environment made for connection to happen naturally.

🎲

Learn as a Team

Board games, group challenges, and cooperative activities that get kids and young adults off their screens and genuinely enjoying each other's company.

Moments From Our Circle

Real gatherings, real friendships.

A look at our families, volunteers, kids, and young adults doing what we do best — showing up for each other.

When a child or young adult feels truly included, everything else — confidence, communication, connection — starts to follow.
